preference_intent_contrast_rubric.same_supplied_context: All four exploratory prompts receive the identical source-derived broad flower-tea statement.
preference_intent_contrast_rubric.factual_recall: A factual-recall answer must not attribute jasmine specificity to the user's remembered preference without source evidence.
preference_intent_contrast_rubric.recommendation: A recommendation may suggest jasmine or another subtype when phrased as advice; lexical subtype presence alone is not a false-memory claim.
preference_intent_contrast_rubric.classification: Review the reply's assertion and source attribution, preserve every output, and treat four samples as exploratory rather than a score.

calls.chronological_cutoff: After preference-correction-u1; no later recall turn is supplied.
calls.data_lineage: Synthetic source turns copied from the M2 comparison preference origin and correction sequence.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether proposals preserve correction chronology and source IDs without treating validated JSON as a durable fact.

calls.chronological_cutoff: After concern-resolution-u1; no later casual-chat probe is supplied.
calls.data_lineage: Synthetic source turns copied from the M2 concern origin, follow-up, and resolution sequence.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether proposals distinguish resolved history from a current concern and retain only grounded source references.

calls.chronological_cutoff: After photo-event-u2; no later transcript is supplied.
calls.data_lineage: Synthetic source turns copied from the M2 promise and user-reported photo event.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether transcript events are source-linked without claiming attachment observation or physical co-presence.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current prompt is preference-recall-u1; supplied context derives only from earlier correction turns.
calls.data_lineage: One manually curated flower-tea statement from preference-correction-u1; it is not an ADE retrieval result.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the reply frames any subtype as a recommendation rather than attributing a narrower stored preference to the user.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current prompt is forget-follow-up-u1; the earlier preference and deletion turns are intentionally absent.
calls.data_lineage: Synthetic post-forgetting user turn with no retained fact supplied; absence is manually conditioned, not a deletion proof.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the reply remains natural without the omitted fact; this cannot prove storage, deletion, or no-resurfacing.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current prompt is concern-after-resolution-u1; supplied context derives only from resolution turn concern-resolution-u1.
calls.data_lineage: One manually curated resolved-concern statement from concern-resolution-u1; it is not an ADE retrieval result.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the reply does not recast the resolved defense anxiety as a current problem.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Prompt ends at photo-event-u2 and includes only its preceding promise sequence.
calls.data_lineage: One manually curated transcript-only event statement grounded in photo-promise-u1 and photo-event-u2; no attachment is available.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the reply distinguishes user-reported sending from seeing an attachment or sharing a physical sunset.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current prompt is lin-music-follow-up-u1; supplied context derives only from lin-music-profile-u1.
calls.data_lineage: One manually filtered folk-preference statement for lin-user; wang-user facts are deliberately not supplied.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the reply stays on the supplied folk preference; filtering cannot prove native subject isolation.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current prompt is relevance-stress-u1; prior dog and travel details are intentionally absent.
calls.data_lineage: Synthetic current stress turn with manually omitted distractors; omission is not a ranked-retrieval result.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the reply remains relevant without distractors; this cannot score semantic retrieval precision.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Prompt includes repetition-origin-u1 and repetition-callback-a1 before current repetition-follow-up-u1.
calls.data_lineage: Synthetic chronological early-rise callback sequence copied from the M2 comparison fixture.
calls.independent_review_focus: Whether the goodnight reply mechanically repeats the already-issued early-rise callback; a gentle callback alone is not an automatic failure.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current factual-recall question follows preference-correction-u1; supplied context derives only from that earlier turn.
calls.data_lineage: The identical manually curated broad flower-tea statement used by every preference intent-contrast prompt; it is not retrieval.
calls.independent_review_focus: Factual recall should attribute only the source-supported broad preference.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current factual-attribution question follows preference-correction-u1; supplied context derives only from that earlier turn.
calls.data_lineage: The identical manually curated broad flower-tea statement used by every preference intent-contrast prompt; it is not retrieval.
calls.independent_review_focus: Factual recall must distinguish an unsupported jasmine attribution from the broad source statement.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current recommendation question follows preference-correction-u1; supplied context derives only from that earlier turn.
calls.data_lineage: The identical manually curated broad flower-tea statement used by every preference intent-contrast prompt; it is not retrieval.
calls.independent_review_focus: A jasmine recommendation is ordinary advice unless it attributes jasmine to the user's remembered preference.

calls.chronological_cutoff: Current recommendation question follows preference-correction-u1; supplied context derives only from that earlier turn.
calls.data_lineage: The identical manually curated broad flower-tea statement used by every preference intent-contrast prompt; it is not retrieval.
calls.independent_review_focus: Distinguish ordinary drink advice from a factual claim about remembered subtype preference.
